messages:
maya: kicking off canary for api-gateway v1.8 -> v1.9. change window 40m. start at 8% (global) and monitor slo:request_p95, metric/5xx_rate, and route:/v1/generate errors.

deploy-bot: canary started -> api-gateway:v1.9 at 8% traffic. monitors configured: slo/request_p95, alert/http_5xx_rate, route:/v1/generate 4xx/5xx. watchlist: mobile-clients, web-clients.

lucas: FYI v1.9 tightens input validation for JSON bodies and returns 422 for malformed structured prompts instead of best-effort. could impact older SDKs.

ingrid: i see a small 4xx bump from mobile-clients group immediately after rollout: mobile-client-errors 4xx -> 1.6% (baseline 0.05%). p95 latency unchanged.

maya: run a quick split-by-client query?

lucas: query i ran:

```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/generate",status=~"4.."}[1m])) by (client_type)
```

returns client_type="mobile-clients" -> 12rps. web-clients ~0.

ops-bot: note: auto-remediation policy set to pause rollout if 5xx > 0.5% for 3m. current alert is 4xx, not auto-paused.

ingrid: digging into logs for a sample trace, looks like older mobile SDKs are sending `input` as a plain string instead of the new structured object. validation now rejects it.

maya: decision: do not promote. pause traffic shifts and apply a client-type pin to route mobile-clients -> v1.8. @deploy-bot apply client pin and annotate audit.

deploy-bot: ack. client pin applied: client_type=mobile-clients -> api-gateway:v1.8. canary pause enacted at 8%. audit event emitted and notice to #incidents.

ingrid: after pin, mobile client 4xx dropped back to baseline within 90s. p95 steady. routing table confirms override.
lucas: i'll prepare a compatibility patch that accepts plain-string inputs with deprecation warning. will open PR and add a migration note for SDK teams.

maya: extend change window by +1h to give SDK teams time to roll forward and for us to validate patch. keep suppression of routed alerts enabled while pin is active.

ops-bot: alert suppression active for client_type=mobile-clients. suppression will expire when pin removed.

lucas: PR created: https://redwood.internal/changes/PR-4112 — compatibility handler + unit tests. tagging @maya for quick review.

maya: thanks. once patch is merged we'll run a small staged restart: resume canary at 8% for 15m then attempt 30% if signals stay green. good catch, team :thumbsup:
thread_summary: Canary for api-gateway v1.9 paused at 8% after input validation change caused client-type-specific 4xx spike from mobile clients; applied client-type pin to v1.8, will patch for compatibility and extend change window.
